title: Watersound "The Pearl of Watersound" 130 Coopersmith Lane
h1: Watersound "The Pearl of Watersound" 130 Coopersmith Lane
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Gated Community with on-site Security- From March 1st to October 31st, 2024, the rental of this property includes one beach service set (2 beach chairs and 1umbrella)- Private Deeded Beach Access- Private heated pool **Pool heating available Oct 1-May 1 for an additional $30/day fee- Wet bar- Gas grill- 5 adult bikes- Golf cart- Ping pong table- Elevator- Garage- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutThis property comes with 3 designated parking spaces. This home permits a maximum of 3 vehicles through the community security gate.DETAILS: A dreamy seaside vacation awaits at The Pearl of WaterSound, a 5-bedroom, 5.5-bathroom home that accommodates up to 12 guests—minutes from the beach boardwalk! Twisting boardwalks wind over sprawling white-sand dunes, painting a picturesque setting for a relaxing getaway. Enjoy 2 community pools or head down to The Big Chill for live music and a signature shake at Mr. Freeze. There’s plenty to love at this property, with tons of indoor and outdoor space, Gulf views from the crow’s nest, and a private pool!Traditional box trim and classic molding create a serene and refined aesthetic inside this 3-story home. High-end appliances—including a Wolf stovetop—in the expansive, open kitchen will delight guests with a flair for cooking. Centrally located with double islands that seat 4 each, it’s easy to entertain while preparing meals. Dual seating areas with plush furnishings frame each end of the great room—1 surrounds a large TV, while the other resides beside the 8-person dining table. Off the hall is a wine cooler and dry bar. Outside, take advantage of the seaside climate with the gas grill and private pool. Also on this floor is 1 guest bedroom with a king bed and a private bathroom.Find additional accommodations on the second floor, consisting of 2 guest bedrooms with king beds and a charming bunk room with 2 twin-over-twin beds.Guests desiring privacy will appreciate the seclusion of the guest bedroom with a king bed on the third floor. A convenient kitchenette with a Keurig and beverage fridge sits beside a cozy seating area with a TV and queen sleeper sofa. Get ready for some friendly competition on the ping-pong table on the enclosed deck or venture up to the crow’s nest for peek-a-boo views of the Gulf and a high-top table for 4—perfect for an evening cocktail as the sun sets or a round of cards.Experience the Emerald Coast’s extraordinary beauty and relaxed atmosphere at The Pearl of WaterSound. Easily explore Scenic 30A with parking for 2 vehicles, 5 complimentary adult bikes, and a 4-seat golf cart. Guests can access all of WaterSound’s beach boardwalks. Book this delightful home today! SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (Sleeps 12):FIRST FLOOR- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower OnlySECOND FLOOR- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Separate- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: Two Twin-over-Twin Bunk Beds, Shared Hallway Bathroom with Shower OnlyTHIRD FLOOR- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Additional Living Area: Queen Sleeper Sofa and Kitchenette*Watersound Community Highlights:-Over 250 Acre Gated Beach Community on the Gulf of Mexico between Seaside and Rosemary Beach-(2) Community Pools (Dunesider Pool in Main Gate and Bridges Pool within the Bridges Gate)-Kayak Rentals-Parks, Walking Trails and Meandering Boardwalks-Bike to Alys, Seacrest and Rosemary Beach-A short walk to The Big ChillPlease Note:*Access to the Watersound Beach Club is not included.*Watersound does not allow golf cart rentals from outside vendors.*Weddings or parties/groups of people or guest of guest are not allowed at this home. If this policy is violated, you may be asked to vacate the property and forfeit any rental payments and be subject to HOA, community, and 360 Blue fines.

body_text_excerpt: Destinations Travel Collections Experiences + Services About Us Homeowners Travel Blog View Gallery Watersound "The Pearl of Watersound" 130 Coopersmith Lane Watersound, FL Bedrooms 5 Beds 9 Sleeps 12 Full Baths 5 Half Baths 1 HOME HIGHLIGHTS: - Gated Community with on-site Security - From March 1st to October 31st, 2024, the rental of this property includes one beach service set (2 beach chairs and 1umbrella) - Private Deeded Beach Access - Private heated pool **Pool heating available Oct 1-May 1 for an additional $30/day fee - Wet bar - Gas grill - 5 adult bikes - Golf cart - Ping pong table - Elevator - Garage - Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkout This property comes with 3 designated parking spaces. This home permits a maximum of 3 vehicles through the community security gate. DETAILS: A dreamy seaside vacation awaits at The Pearl of WaterSound, a 5-bedroom, 5.5-bathroom home that accommodates up to 12 guests—minutes from the beach boardwalk! Twisting boardwalks wind over sprawling white-sand dunes, painting a picturesque setting for a relaxing getaway. Enjoy 2 community pools or head down to The Big Chill for live music and a signature shake at Mr. Freeze. There’s plenty to love at this property, with tons of indoor and outdoor space, Gulf views from the crow’s nest, and a private pool! Traditional box trim and classic molding create a serene and refined aesthetic inside this 3-story home. High-end appliances—including a Wolf stovetop—in the expansive, open kitchen will delight guests with a flair for cooking. Centrally located with double islands that seat 4 each, it’s easy to entertain while preparing meals. Dual seating areas with plush furnishings frame each end of the great room—1 surrounds a large TV, while the other resides beside the 8-person dining table. Off the hall is a wine cooler and dry bar. Outside, take advantage of the seaside climate with the gas grill and private pool. Also on this floor is 1 guest bedroom with a king bed and a private bathroom. Find additional accommodations on the second floor, consisting of 2 guest bedrooms with king beds and a charming bunk room with 2 twin-over-twin beds. Guests desiring privacy will appreciate the seclusion of the guest bedroom with a king bed on the third floor. A convenient kitchenette with a Keurig and beverage fridge sits beside a cozy seating area with a TV and queen sleeper sofa. Get ready for some friendly competition on the ping-pong table on the enclosed deck or venture up to the crow’s nest for peek-a-boo views of the Gulf and a high-top table for 4—perfect for an evening cocktail as the sun sets or a round of cards. Experience the Emerald Coast’s extraordinary beauty and relaxed atmosphere at The Pearl of WaterSound. Easily explore Scenic 30A with parking for 2 vehicles, 5 complimentary adult bikes, and a 4-seat golf cart. Guests can access all of WaterSound’s beach boardwalks. Book this delightful home today! SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (Sleeps 12): FIRST FLOOR - Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only SECOND FLOOR - Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Separate - Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only - Guest Bedroom: Two Twin-over-Twin Bunk Beds, Shared Hallway Bathroom with Shower Only THIRD FLOOR - Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only - Additional Living Area: Queen Sleeper Sofa and Kitchenette *Watersound Community Highlights: -Over 250 Acre Gated Beach Community on the Gulf of Mexico between Seaside and Rosemary Beach -(2) Community Pools (Dunesider Pool in Main Gate and Bridges Pool within the Bridges Gate) -Kayak Rentals -Parks, Walking Trails and Meandering Boardwalks -Bike to Alys, Seacrest and Rosemary Beach -A short walk to The Big Chill Please Note: *Access to the Watersound Beach Club is not included. *Watersound does not allow golf cart rentals from outside vendors. *Weddings or parties/groups of people or guest of guest are not allowed at this home. If this policy is violated, you may be asked to vacate the property and forfeit any rental payments and be subject to HOA, community, and 360 Blue fines.
